quarterly_data.quarter: IBM press release: IBM Delivers New Quantum Processors, Software, and Algorithm (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: IBM (release): unveiled IBM Quantum Nighthawk, its most advanced quantum processor, expected to be delivered to IBM users by the end of 2025 with 120 qubits linked by 218 next-generation tunable couplers; IBM also introduced IBM Quantum Loon and said primary fabrication of its quantum processor wafers is being undertaken at an advanced 300mm wafer fabrication facility at NY Creates' Albany NanoTech Complex.
